question: After resolving the current-main conflicts, should this land with explicit local-root enforcement and the additive media SDK surface as the intended compatibility contract?
rationale: The branch deliberately makes unsafe injected-reader behavior fail closed and expands public Plugin SDK surface in a protected delivery path; only a maintainer can approve that upgrade contract and the final conflict resolution.

options.title: Resolve and retain hardening
options.body: Rebase or merge current main, preserve the canonical loader and additive APIs, and validate real WhatsApp media delivery before landing.

options.title: Pause for compatibility redesign
options.body: Keep the PR open if existing injected readers must remain supported until an explicit bounded-reader migration or deprecation path is designed.

recommendation.title: Resolve and retain hardening
recommendation.body: Rebase or merge current main, preserve the canonical loader and additive APIs, and validate real WhatsApp media delivery before landing.
